operations.description: This endpoint retrieves villager information from the entire *Animal Crossing* series, with the option to filter by species, personality, game, and/or birthday. Filters use the AND operator (e.g. asking for villagers who have species `frog` and personality `smug` will return all smug frogs). Note that villagers only include the animals that act as residents. Special characters, such as Tom Nook and Isabelle, are not accessed through this endpoint.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] villagers [PARAMS] accept birthday birthmonth excludedetails game key name nhdetails personality species thumbsize version x [SCHEMA] 400 error villager
